messages:
maria_fin: Partner claims an AWS Marketplace credit for a reseller account we bill through. They sent a credit note for $12,400 dated 2026-03-18 — I can't find a matching negative line on our reseller invoice.
ajay_sales: Partner emailed partners@ with the PDF earlier. They referenced marketplace settlement id MKT-98765 and marketplace invoice AWSINV-20260318-9856.
aws_billing_bot: Automated notice: Marketplace settlement MKT-98765 posted on 2026-03-18. See: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/settlements/MKT-98765
maria_fin: I pulled our payer view and only see a -$12,150 adjustment for that period, not $12,400. small delta of $250 — could be tax, fees, or currency rounding.
lina_rev: Tagging revenue ops — we need to decide if we 1) pass full credit to partner/reseller, 2) net against our payable, or 3) issue contra invoice. Who signs the GL impact? :thinking_face:
greg_ops: Quick check — can you paste the partner CSV snippet? sometimes there are multi-line adjustments per SKU.
ajay_sales: pasted CSV from partner:
```
settlement_id,sku,amount,fee,tax
MKT-98765,RED-CORE-1,-12400,0,0
```
ajay_sales: partner insists it's a single credit line for the reseller contract (reseller_id: R-3321).
maria_fin: OK. Two action items: (A) Finance to reconcile the $250 gap with AWS fee/tax detail; (B) if CSV matches, approve issuing a credit memo to the reseller for $12,400. Need Lina's signoff for revenue booking.
lina_rev: I reviewed revenue impact — we can book a contra of $12,400 to revenue if it's customer-facing. Approve pending proof of transfer from AWS that shows net to our payer account.
maria_fin: To be safe, I'll request the partner to share the marketplace settlement export (full CSV) and a screenshot of the AWS settlement transaction showing net debit to our payer account. Email sent.
ajay_sales: Partner responded: "sharing export now" — uploaded to the shared folder and pinged marketplace support to confirm the $12,400 net settlement. :thumbsup:
aws_billing_bot: file uploaded: https://files.redwood.com/partners/R-3321/MKT-98765-full.csv
maria_fin: Found the tax breakdown in the full CSV: $12400 = $12,150 credit + $250 sales tax reversal. That explains the delta. Good.
greg_ops: Great — GL guidance: use revenue code 4002 (contra-marketplace) and tax code TXR-01. I'll create the journal template.
lina_rev: Approved. Maria, proceed to issue a credit memo to reseller R-3321 for $12,400. Copy me on the memo.
maria_fin: Will do. I'll create credit memo CM-20260319-778 and apply to the next invoice cycle. Noting audit evidence: partner CSV + AWS settlement screenshot + support case #.
ajay_sales: Noting partner happy. Closing loop with them once credit applied. :white_check_mark:
maria_fin: Closing notes: credit applied on 2026-03-20, journal posted 2026-03-20, case with AWS (CASE-4598) archived. Thanks everyone.
